This paper presents a systematic pipeline for generating high-quality, ultra-detailed image captions, encompassing both pre-processing and post-processing stages.

To enhance comprehensiveness, we introduce an expansion strategy based on Large Language Models (LLMs), defining eight descriptive dimensions to refine and extend captions, which serve as seed data for training a proprietary captioner model.
Experimental results demonstrate that our ultra-detailed captions significantly enhance LVLMs’ perception and cognitive abilities across multiple vision-language benchmarks.
The code and dataset are available at https://github.com/yuzeng0-0/UltraCaption.
Using high-quality corrected data, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and develop a critic-rewrite pipeline, training a sentence-level critic model to mitigate hallucinations.
